title: 第5章 轻车熟路第6章 死诞者
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 在无数已被遗忘的墓碑环绕着的那座山巅，螺旋剑顺利刺入祭坛篝火的余烬中。
剑锋内部蕴含的火源与余烬达成了某种特殊的共鸣，伴随点点火苗窜起，沉沦了不知道多少年的死寂，在这一刻被熊熊火焰所代替。
于这片世界而言，跳动的火焰象征着生命。
火焰重燃，意味着秩序开始重新运转。
对于宁语她们这些闯入冰冷地底世界的人而言，眼前的篝火具有某种令人着迷的吸引力。
那是一种，可以让人远离冰冷、痛苦、死亡的温暖力量。
在螺旋剑点燃篝火的那一瞬间，所有人的双眸里都出现了短暂的失神，甚至一度忘记了妖鬼的浪潮已经漫过辛之墓群，正在朝着这座山头涌上来。
火焰能够触及人心深处最脆弱的那部分东西，即便最是心如磐石的战士，面对纯粹的篝火也不免惆怅。
这算是火焰的一种特殊设定吧——它能让人短暂emo一下。
不过珲伍例外。
最开始轮回的那几个周目里，在冰原、深渊或者死寂的虚空中，偶尔独坐在篝火面前，配合系统恰到好处给予的纯音乐bgm，珲伍确实无法避免回想起那一张张熟悉却又已经逝去的人脸。
但随着重复逝去的次数足够多，珲伍已经彻底麻木。
现在，这个世界里的所有角色，无论友好的还是敌对的，对他而言都只是npc而已。
对话和过场动画都是可以跳过的。
因为他们并不具备人格，无法在珲伍心中掀起波澜。
于是在宁语等人短暂恍惚之际。
珲伍已经先行一步伸手触碰篝火，身形逐渐被火光包裹，淡去。
他直接传送离开了地下世界，没有半分留恋的意思。
火光萦绕，在彻底充斥整片视野的时刻又迅速褪去。
在那之后，珲伍眼前的画面已不再是冰冷深邃的地下世界，取而代之的是一片安静祥和的古老森林。
目光所及之处尽是蜿蜒缠绕的橡树藤蔓，以及在夜色下焕发微弱荧光的蕈类物。
这就是，梦开始的地方——迷魅森林。
由于这周目丢失了等级数值，显然已经没有了速通的希望，不过反倒是让珲伍可以偶尔停下步伐，做一些“没有意义”
的举动。
比如：
他站起身之后原地狠吸了一口地表世界的空气。
在这片世界还没有被修罗的死亡黑焰搞得一团糟之前，连空气都是香甜的。
那么接下来，还是回归常规路线。
昏暗的森林深处，珲伍在不具备任何参照物的情况下找准了方向。
这里四面八方的画面如出一辙，到处都是交错的藤蔓、臃肿的树干以及星星点点的蕈类荧光，但这迷宫般的迷魅森林对珲伍而言其实无比熟悉。
即便数值面板上的“感应”
栏点数为0，但珲伍在这片密林里并不需要感官去辨别方向，路都刻在自己脑子里。
要知道，这可是整个世界里为数不多几张做深呼吸不会掉血条的地图之一。
回到迷魅森林那就等同于回家了呀，人在自家客厅里怎么可能会迷路呢？
当然，感应点数为0的坏处就是，珲伍各方面感官变得史无前例的闭塞。
content_en:
Poof——
On the top of the mountain surrounded by countless forgotten tombstones, the spiral sword stabbed smoothly into the embers of the altar bonfire.
The fire source contained in the sword's edge reached a special resonance with the embers, and as little flames sprang up, the silence that had sunk for countless years was replaced by blazing flames at this moment.
To this world, beating flames symbolize life.
The rekindling of the flame means that order begins to operate again.
For Ning Yu and others who broke into the cold underground world, the bonfire in front of them had some kind of fascinating attraction.
It is a warm power that can keep people away from coldness, pain, and death.
At the moment when the spiral sword ignited the bonfire, everyone's eyes were briefly blank, and they even forgot that the wave of demons and ghosts had already passed through the Tombs of Xin and was rushing up the mountain.
Flames can touch the most fragile parts of people's hearts. Even the most stone-hearted warrior can't help but feel melancholy when faced with a pure bonfire.
This can be regarded as a special setting of flame - it can make people emo briefly.
But Hui Wu is an exception.
In the first few weeks of reincarnation, in the ice fields, abyss or the dead void, occasionally sitting alone in front of a campfire, with the pure music BGM provided by the system just right, Hui Wu could not avoid recalling those familiar but long-gone faces.
But as enough repetitions passed by, Hui Wu became completely numb.
Now, all characters in this world, whether friendly or hostile, are just NPCs to him.
Conversations and cutscenes are skippable.
Because they do not have personality, they cannot make waves in Hui Wu's heart.
So when Ning Yu and others were briefly in a trance.
Hui Wu had already taken the first step and reached out to touch the bonfire, and his figure was gradually wrapped in the firelight and faded away.
He teleported directly and left the underground world without any intention of lingering.
The firelight lingered, then quickly faded away as it completely filled the entire field of vision.
After that, the picture in front of Hui Wu was no longer the cold and deep underground world, but was replaced by a quiet and peaceful ancient forest.
As far as the eye can see, there are winding oak vines and mushrooms that glow faintly in the night.
This is where the dream begins - the enchanted forest.
Due to the loss of level values in this week's game, there is obviously no hope of speedrunning. However, it allows Hui Wu to stop occasionally and do some "meaningless" things.
action.
For example:
"Hi-chi!"
He stood up and took a deep breath of air from the surface world.
Before this world was messed up by Shura's black flames of death, even the air was sweet.
Then, let’s return to the regular route.
Deep in the dim forest, Hui Wu found the right direction without any reference.
The pictures here are the same in all directions, with intertwined vines, bloated tree trunks, and dots of fluorescent mushrooms everywhere, but this maze-like enchanted forest is actually very familiar to Hui Wu.
Even if the "sensing" on the numerical panel
The number of column points is 0, but Hui Wu doesn't need his senses to identify the direction in this dense forest, the road is engraved in his mind.
You know, this is one of the few maps in the world where taking a deep breath will not drop the health bar.
Returning to the Enchanted Forest is the same as going home. How can one get lost in his own living room?
Of course, the disadvantage of having 0 sensing points is that Huiwu's senses in all aspects become unprecedentedly blocked.
